cleanup: 4 degenerate gaussians removed (0.002%), the largest 4.77 in scale against an object diagonal of 1.00, i.e. more than 5000x the median. Also rotated 90 degrees about X: the generator put this one's up axis along Z while the dataset's canonical up is -Y.
caveats: Reoriented from the generator's frame (its up axis came out along Z) into the dataset's canonical up = -Y.
The input photograph shows the tower's upper shaft, sphere and antenna; the base below that is not in the data.
